observations.title: CVE-2026-133469: Vates Xen Orchestra Improper Validation of Specified Type of Input Vulnerability
observations.summary: Vates Xen Orchestra contains an improper validation of specified type of input vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and perform actions with administrative privileges via a specially crafted authentication token containing an empty JSON object.

observations.title: CVE-2025-41450: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Improper Authentication Vulnerability

observations.title: CVE-2023-25914: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Path Traversal Vulnerability

observations.summary: Mitel MiCollab contains a not failing securely vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication controls and perform unauthorized actions.

observations.title: CVE-2026-133275: Mitel MiCollab Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability

observations.title: CVE-2026-133311: Mitel MiCollab Weak Authentication Vulnerability

observations.title: CVE-2026-133303: Mitel MiCollab XML Injection Vulnerability

observations.title: CVE-2026-133323: Mitel MiCollab OS Command Injection Vulnerability
observations.summary: Mitel MiCollab contains an improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command (OS command injection) vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary system commands.
